description: This file defines the 'WeightPackageSessionLine' class, which models a single line item or package in a shipment, including package dimensions, weight, shipment box type, and sequence ID. It provides constructors, getters, setters, and a method to apply the line's data to a shipment package within an OFBiz-based system.

classes.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
classes.description: Represents a shipment weight package line with attributes like dimensions, weight, shipment box type, and sequence ID, and provides functionality to associate the line with a shipment package.

methods.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the package line with provided details. Throws GeneralException on error.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the order ID associated with the package line.

methods.name: getShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Returns the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: setShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Sets the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: getWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Returns the sequence ID of the weight package.

methods.name: setWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Sets the sequence ID of the weight package.

methods.name: getShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: setShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: applyLineToPackage
methods.description: Associates this line with a shipment package by calling the 'addShipmentContentToPackage' service, managing errors through ServiceUtil.
